tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on The Externally Set Assignment Component 2

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring the externally set assignment component 2. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to the externally set assignment component 2, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with the externally set assignment component 2. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with the externally set assignment component 2. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on The Externally Set Assignment Component 2

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Choose one ESA starting point and plan your preparatory work. Create a timeline showing how you would address each AO during the preparatory period. Explain how you would use the 10 hours supervised time. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: show thorough, independent preparation addressing all four AOs; create a realistic, detailed timeline; demonstrate understanding that preparation is MARKED alongside the final piece; explain how the 10 hours would be used efficiently; plan for contingencies. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
